== Notes ==
* If standing in [[lava]] under Melandru's Resilience, you will experience +1 net health regeneration and +2 energy regeneration.
* Can be used with most skills that [[Condition#Skills_which_inflict_conditions_on_oneself|inflict conditions on self]].
** However, be aware that henchmen or heroes in your party will attempt to remove conditions from you. Inform human players that you don't require condition removal.
